## Installation

To install, run the script:

    curl -fsSL https://get.docker.com | sh
    sudo usermod -aG docker $USER

Then start the stack with `docker compose up -d`. Set `API_TOKEN` in your .env file and restart.
To reset the admin password, run `docker exec -it app reset-password`.
